about: What the shipped readers do with each example packet. `swift` is the result of `coop-packet check <packet>` (Packages/SessionKitTools/Sources/CoopPacket), which imports with this build's SpokenMarginsPackageArchive and with Build 29's frozen copy (Packages/SessionKit/Tests/ShippedReader); both gave the same answer for every packet except the two `proposal-` packets, where `swift` names what Build 29 did, recorded 2026-10-16 on next at 6a665eac; the three Listening Map proposal packets were added and checked 2026-10-17 on next at bb279271. `reference` is the code spoken_margins_format.py reports. scripts/tests/test_portable_formats.py checks the reference reader against this file.

writtenBy.*: spoken_margins_format.py corpus, from the two Swift-written packets

article-reference.spokenmargins.rule: an article Margin anchored by quote, item by reference

podcast-reference.spokenmargins.rule: a podcast Margin placed by time, item by reference

article-embedded-text.spokenmargins.rule: app-authored text travels inside the packet; its edition hashes match

unknown-optional-artifact.spokenmargins.rule: an optional artifact of an unknown kind is skipped

unknown-commentary-fields.spokenmargins.rule: unknown fields inside a Margin or its anchor are ignored

private-link.spokenmargins.rule: a link with an access token opens, but the exporter would have dropped it; --strict fails it

proposal-excluded-scene-summary.spokenma.swift: imports; Build 29: invalidManifest("scene summary asset is absent or has the wrong role")
proposal-excluded-scene-summary.spokenma.rule: a summary on an excluded scene is stripped before it is checked; Build 29 has no such step and refuses

proposal-dropped.spokenmargins.swift: imports; Build 29: invalidManifest("Listening Map proposal order is invalid")
proposal-dropped.spokenmargins.rule: a Listening Map proposal that breaks a scene rule is left out and its Margins import; Build 29 refuses

invalid-edition-mismatch.spokenmargins.rule: the embedded text is not the edition the item's hash names

invalid-future-package-version.spokenmar.rule: a newer package version is refused, not guessed at

invalid-insecure-link.spokenmargins.swift: invalidManifest("item fields are absent or out of bounds")
invalid-insecure-link.spokenmargins.rule: every link in the item is https

invalid-proposal-order.spokenmargins.swift: invalidManifest("Listening Map proposal order is invalid")
invalid-proposal-order.spokenmargins.rule: a proposal that keeps every scene rule but has its scenes out of order is refused

invalid-malformed-voice-asset.spokenmarg.rule: a voice asset must be MPEG-4 audio

invalid-redaction-disabled.spokenmargins.swift: invalidManifest("sender or redaction fields are invalid")
invalid-redaction-disabled.spokenmargins.rule: a packet that does not omit raw audio is refused

invalid-tampered-margin.spokenmargins.rule: a Margin edited after export is refused

invalid-unknown-manifest-field.spokenmar.rule: an unknown manifest key is refused

invalid-unknown-required-artifact.spoken.rule: a required artifact of an unknown kind is refused

invalid-unknown-required-capability.spok.rule: an unknown required capability is refused

invalid-unsafe-entry.spokenmargins.rule: an archive entry outside the allowed paths is refused
